note: Fixed narrator lines. They never contain guests' names. audio is the file name: a Show Pack keeps it in its own audio/ folder. Without the file, the line shows as a caption only.

lines.text: Watch the ball, not my lovely face. Under it goes…
Round and round they go, faster than a taxi meter on a Friday night!
Right, freeze! Go on then, clever clogs. Which one is it?
You beauty! You actually tracked it. Pure genius.
Wrong! Empty! Zero points! Absolute shambles.
Too slow! Did you nod off, or did your finger fall off?
Ooh, wrong cup. Check your phone, there's a forfeit waiting.
Ludicrous speed activated! Good luck, you'll bloody need it.
